cover.hook: You can now edit an Instagram Story after you post it. Are you in?
cover.label: 5 social updates worth knowing right now

slides.headline: to [[edit a Story]] after you post it
slides.sub: Instagram now lets you fix typos and mistakes in a published Story for up to 15 minutes. Multi-photo posting and new stickers arrived too.

slides.headline: checks if media came from [[TikTok AI]]
slides.sub: Upload an image or video to see if TikTok's AI tools made it, even without an account. A likeness detection tool for creators was also announced.

slides.headline: hours of YouTube watched on TV [[every day]]
slides.sub: YouTube will now add co-viewers to CTV view counts, so a family on one couch counts as more than one viewer.

slides.headline: Meta's Edits app is now [[on iPad]]
slides.sub: A bigger composition screen puts more editing options in view at once, alongside new tools and effects.

slides.headline: Meta's Creator Dashboard [[comes to desktop]]
slides.sub: The new dashboard replaces other management tools as the main place to manage your presence. Expect a learning curve.

take.headline: Less rework, [[more control]]
take.sub: Edit after posting, verify what is AI, count real viewers. Pick one habit to tighten this week.

cta.headline: Comment [[UPDATE]] and I'll send you the full list
cta.sub: All five updates, with the sources, in one place.

stories.name: story-thu
stories.headline: LinkedIn adds a [[monetization tab]]
stories.sub: Creator analytics will get a separate tab with guides to income streams, alongside content and audience analytics. Rolling out soon.

stories.name: story-fri
stories.headline: Will you use the new [[Story edit]] window?
stories.context: Instagram now lets you edit a Story for 15 minutes after posting.

stories.name: story-sat
stories.headline: TikTok adds [[likeness detection]]
stories.sub: Creators verify their ID with a third-party partner, and the system flags uploads that appear to use their image.

stories.name: story-sun
stories.headline: YouTube counts [[co-viewers]] on TV
stories.sub: CTV view counts will now reflect several people watching together, not one viewer per session.

stories.name: story-mon
stories.headline: Do you edit video on an [[iPad]]?
stories.context: Meta's Edits app now has an iPad version with a larger editing screen.

stories.name: story-tue
stories.headline: Meta's new [[Creator Dashboard]]
stories.sub: It is now live on the web and replaces other tools as the main place to manage your presence. Take ten minutes to explore it.

stories.name: story-wed
stories.headline: Try one [[new tool]] this week
stories.sub: Story editing, the Creator Dashboard or Edits on iPad. Pick one, test it on a real post, and note what you learn.
